@anonymous_statement : ∀ {n N : ℕ} (f rho g : SphereConfiguration n N → ℝ),
  ContMDiff (sphereProductModel n N) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 1 f →
    ContMDiff (sphereProductModel n N) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 1 rho →
      ContMDiff (sphereProductModel n N) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 2 g →
        have V := fun i x => rho x • sphereProductGradient g i x;
        Integrable (sphereProductDivergence V) (sphereProductMeasure n N) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => f x * sphereProductDivergence V x) (sphereProductMeasure n N) ∧
            Integrable (fun x => rho x * ∑ i, ⟪sphereProductGradient f i x, sphereProductGradient g i x⟫)
                (sphereProductMeasure n N) ∧
              ∫ (x : SphereConfiguration n N), sphereProductDivergence V x ∂sphereProductMeasure n N = 0 ∧
                ∫ (x : SphereConfiguration n N), f x * sphereProductDivergence V x ∂sphereProductMeasure n N =
                  -∫ (x : SphereConfiguration n N),
                      rho x * ∑ i, ⟪sphereProductGradient f i x, sphereProductGradient g i x⟫ ∂sphereProductMeasure n N

@[reducible] def SpherePoint : (n : ℕ) →
  Set (SphereAmbient n) :=
fun n => sphere 0 1

def sphereProductModel : (n N : ℕ) →
  ModelWithCorners ℝ (Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (ModelPi fun x => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
fun n N => ModelWithCorners.pi fun x => 𝓡 n
def sphereSurfaceMeasure : (n : ℕ) →
  Measure ↑(SpherePoint n) :=
fun n => volume.toSphere
def sphereUniformMeasure : (n : ℕ) →
  Measure ↑(SpherePoint n) :=
fun n => ((sphereSurfaceMeasure n) univ)⁻¹ • sphereSurfaceMeasure n
def sphereProductMeasure : (n N : ℕ) →
  Measure (SphereConfiguration n N) :=
fun n N => Measure.pi fun x => sphereUniformMeasure n
def sphereRadialExtension.{u_1} : {n : ℕ} →
  {A : Type u_1} → [Zero A] → (↑(SpherePoint n) → A) → SphereAmbient n → A :=
fun {n} {A} [Zero A] f x => if hx : x = 0 then 0 else f ((homeomorphUnitSphereProd (SphereAmbient n)) ⟨x, hx⟩).1
def sphereTangentGradient : {n : ℕ} →
  (↑(SpherePoint n) → ℝ) → ↑(SpherePoint n) → SphereAmbient n :=
fun {n} f x => (ℝ ∙ ↑x)ᗮ.starProjection (gradient (sphereRadialExtension f) ↑x)
def sphereTangentDivergence : {n : ℕ} →
  (↑(SpherePoint n) → SphereAmbient n) → ↑(SpherePoint n) → ℝ :=
fun {n} V x =>
  coordinateDivergence (sphereRadialExtension V) ↑x
def sphereProductGradient : {n N : ℕ} →
  (SphereConfiguration n N → ℝ) → Fin N → SphereConfiguration n N → SphereAmbient n :=
fun {n N} f i x => sphereTangentGradient (fun y => f (Function.update x i y)) (x i)
def sphereProductDivergence : {n N : ℕ} →
  (Fin N → SphereConfiguration n N → SphereAmbient n) → SphereConfiguration n N → ℝ :=
fun {n N} V x => ∑ i, sphereTangentDivergence (fun y => V i (Function.update x i y)) (x i)
